caption: The drawing depicts a round plate or dish with a decorative, ornamental design in its center. The plate has a brown outer rim and an inner border featuring a wavy line pattern in red and greenish hues. Within the central area of the plate, an intricate, symmetrical motif resembling a vase or urn with elaborate, curling floral or vine-like extensions dominates the composition, rendered in shades of brown, green, and some lighter colors with visible texture from brushstrokes. At the base of the vase or urn shape, the numerals "1791" are prominently inscribed, indicating a date. The background of the central design is a muted pale green or greyish tone with scattered patches and darker areas, contributing to an aged appearance. The plate is positioned on an off-white or beige rectangular surface, with the artist's signature present in the lower right corner below the plate.
title: Pa. German Plate
